# P37.48 — Aggregate lanes (S3/S4/S7) (R11-ACQ-20)

Round-11 row 473 · `implement-spec spec=docs/tickets/473_P37.48__aggregate-lanes.md live_verification=false` · base `r11/P37.47-tier-2-reuse-wave`

## What this is

The I8 §6.2 Wave-D tranche's **aggregate lanes**: Socrata `$group` and
ArcGIS `outStatistics` aggregate lanes over the P36.6/ACQ-10 machinery —
payments/contract registers as **vendor × period spend totals** on
`payee:` subjects (S7 — natural-person payees are screened out at
extraction, never materialised), ShotSpotter/alert datasets as
**district/beat × month alert counts** on `programme_area:` subjects (S4 —
never an alert point or address), and ATE violation datasets as
**site × period enforcement counts** (S3 — never a per-violation row).
`live_verification=false`: this PR lands the engineering + fixture
surfaces only; every source stays `ingestion_permitted=false` and the
operator's OP-26 Wave-D flip under ING-GO-D is the only route to a live
fetch. Not an OM-20 row — no live legs ran, no production mutations.

## Machinery (P36.6 aggregate transport extended)

`connectors/dot_511.py`:
- **`payee` subject kind** — a `payee:` aggregate subject mints the
  published vendor/payee bucket of a payments or contract-spend table:
  entity + `external_id` + `vendor` (entity-ref candidate) +
  `published_by` (provenance) + optional `buyer` + `payment_total`
  claims (`{period, currency, measure}` beside the decimal value — cents
  preserved). No `technology` claim: a spend bucket is a procurement
  record, never a device class.
- **Two S7 screens** — the committed `payee_allowlist` (required on the
  workbook lane, optional on any payee target) plus a
  `natural_person_signal` fail-closed gate: a person-shaped group row
  lands `camera_record_rejected`, recorded, never a subject.
- **`count` function** — SoQL `count(*)` / ArcGIS `statisticType=count`
  (alert and violation-row counts).
- **`year` + `declared` period kinds** — `date_trunc_y(<field>)` on
  SoQL; `declared` stamps the committed `aggregate_period_label` (the
  `where` window is the evidence — Detroit's layer holds only a
  row-level datetime).
- **`state_checkbook_xlsx` kind** — the WA fiscal.wa.gov biennium
  workbooks: one download per period, streamed stdlib-only into the
  declared vendor × FY groups; the committed `payee_allowlist` is the
  ONLY emit screen — the capture carries natural-person reimbursement
  payees (custody-internal evidence only) and a non-allowlisted payee
  never becomes a group row.
- `vendor`/`buyer` join `_PARTNER_PREDICATES` (partner-ref twins);
  `payee`, `payment_total`, `vendor`, `buyer`, `published_by` join the
  connector predicate allowlist (vocab 2026.11.13); `payee` +
  `payment_total` registered in `ontology/vocab/predicates.yaml`.

## The 36 targets (12 sources — 11 gated + `camreg_montgomery_md_ate` widened)

- **S7 payee lanes (25)** — Socrata `$group` vendor × period
  `payment_total`: 11-dataset checkbook family
  (`camreg_us_socrata_hosted_vendor`), Cook County awarded contracts,
  TX DIR VSR (2 datasets), Mesa expenditures, Delaware checkbook, NJ
  YourMoney, Chicago Payments (new source `camreg_il_chicago_payments`),
  and 7 WA biennium workbooks (`state_checkbook_xlsx`). Every Socrata
  lane's committed `where` is the reviewed surveillance-vendor allowlist
  — no payee row is ever read or captured.
- **S4 programme-area lanes (10)** — Oakland ShotSpotter 5 datasets
  (beat × month), Chicago Violence Reduction ShotSpotter (district ×
  month), Detroit ShotSpotter 4 declared-year lanes (council_district ×
  year window via `outStatistics count(incident_id)`).
- **S3 enforcement lane (1)** — Montgomery school-bus
  `intersection × quarter_name` `count(*)` `enforcement_count`
  (`ate-school-bus-stop-arm`; the citation-named bus field is F-330
  denied and never requested).
- **Recorded findings (2 seats, no targets)** —
  `camreg_us_ate_camera_location_and_per` (the I4-C050 channel's
  aggregate members are all dispositioned — landed P36.6/P36.7, blocked
  Part-VIII, or the Montgomery lane above) and
  `camreg_us_body_worn_camera` (host `priv-data.ojp.usdoj.gov` does not
  resolve at registration, 2026-11-13 — recorded, stays unmapped).

screening, programme-area alert counts, school-bus enforcement counts,
declaration fail-closed checks, gated-source live refusal, +0 replay.
`sig-connectors validate` OK; review-status/batch pins updated.

## Honest scope notes

- `observed_count` on payee/alert group rows is a plan placeholder where
  no group-row count was read — the paging bound fails loud rather than
  silently truncate.
- No per-source HG-03 flips were performed or claimed — every source
  stays `ingestion_permitted=false`; the OP-26 Wave-D flips are the
  operator's.
- Fulton County `mxhc-krcg` timed out at registration probing — recorded
  on the family lane, no target.
- The I4-C050 channel seat and the BWC dataset carry recorded findings
  (all members dispositioned / host unresolvable) — no targets.
